about: [O5] A hideout's shootout (the warehouse), profile idle (brief O5 §3): in by its door, they know my face (the warning), they draw (the gun kit's men: the stand-in for O4's), the fight: idle loses, warned; good clears it.

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('warehouse'), F = s.frame; const p = F.w(0, 3.0); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(p.x, p.z); N.controller.setPose(p.x, p.z, F.yaw(0), -0.05); return 1; })()

steps.walk: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('warehouse'), F = s.frame; return [[0, -1.8]].map(([x, z]) => { const p = F.w(x, z); return [p.x, p.z]; }); })()

steps.eval: (() => { const s = G.city.places.byId.get('warehouse'); const st = s.live && s.live.run && s.live.run.st; return JSON.stringify({ men: st ? st.men.length : null, down: st ? st.men.filter((h) => !h.alive).length : null, cleared: !!s.state.cleared, deaths: G.counters.deaths, hp: G.health.hp }); })()
